correct_text:
An optional Layer 3 Address Group sub-TLV is a variable-length sub-
TLV that includes the IP Prefix and Prefix Length fields used by
the Session-Sender to select the Session-Reflectors for a response.
The format of the Layer 3 Address Group sub-TLV is presented in
Figure 3.
notes: The field is called Prefix Length, not IP Prefix Length (see Figure 3)

orig_text: A two-octet field. The value is variable and MUST NOT be smaller than 12 octets.
correct_text: A two-octet field. The value is variable and MUST NOT be smaller than 8 octets.
notes: The fixed Value fields of the Reflected Test Packet Control TLV (Figure 1) total only 8 octets: Length of the Reflected Packet (2) + Number of the Reflected Packets (2) + Interval Between the Reflected Packets (4). Per RFC 8972 Section 4, the TLV Length counts the Value field only (it excludes the 4-octet STAMP TLV Flags/Type/Length header). Therefore the minimum should be 8, not 12.
